video_title: What You NEED To Know About NBA Expansion

quotes.speaker: Ramona Shelburne
quotes.summary_phrase: NBA expansion process expected to conclude by the end of the year
quotes.excerpt: this process is going to conclude by the end of the year
quotes.quote: This process is going to conclude by the end of the year, and the question is just about how much money is the NBA going to get. We started this off and everybody thought Vegas would be six to eight billion and Seattle would be four to six billion. I just toss around billions like it's nothing.

quotes.speaker: Ramona Shelburne
quotes.summary_phrase: Josh Kroenke and Bob Iger's pivot to buying the Lakers
quotes.excerpt: Josh Kroenke and Bob Iger made that pivot to go buy the Lakers
quotes.quote: Vegas has obviously blown past that. That's partially why Josh Kroenke and Bob Iger made that pivot to go buy the Lakers because they were like, if we're going to spend 12 and a half billion dollars on a franchise and building an arena in Vegas, why not make a call to Mark Walter who needs some liquidity?

quotes.speaker: Ramona Shelburne
quotes.summary_phrase: Mark Walter's financial issues and the federal investigation
quotes.excerpt: Mark used money and it wasn't disclosed properly
quotes.quote: Essentially, Mark used money and it wasn't disclosed properly and the state investigators and the federal investigators are saying, you need to go put that money that you used to buy these sports teams back. We don't really care where that money comes from. You can sell any of your companies, you can take any of the money out of any of these companies or teams, but you got to put it back and then you got to classify it properly.

quotes.speaker: Ramona Shelburne
quotes.summary_phrase: Potential buyers interested in purchasing the Sparks
quotes.excerpt: there are teams and there are groups that are interested in buying the Sparks
quotes.quote: There are teams and there are groups that are interested in buying the Sparks. I've been hearing about this for a couple months now. It's the guy Jose Feliciano who just bought the Padres, there's a woman named Karen Northman who runs Monarch Collective, that's a big women's sports investment fund. They're in exclusivity on this deal, but that doesn't mean they're going to get it because the NBA has to decide, do we want a non-NBA owner to buy a WNBA team?

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Mark Walter may sell the Sparks for around 750 million
quotes.excerpt: he may sell the Sparks for around 750 million
quotes.quote: There's been some reporting that he may sell the Sparks for around 750 million. He bought them for 10 million in 2014.

quotes.speaker: Ramona Shelburne
quotes.summary_phrase: Mark Walter assumed debt rather than purchasing the Sparks
quotes.excerpt: I wouldn't even say he bought them for 10 million. I think he just assumed the debt.
quotes.quote: I wouldn't even say he bought them for 10 million. I think he just assumed the debt.

quotes.speaker: Ramona Shelburne
quotes.summary_phrase: Seattle and Vegas are the frontrunners for NBA expansion
quotes.excerpt: Seattle is just sitting right there around six
quotes.quote: Seattle is just sitting right there around six. Sam Halloway's group, she's got Andy Jassy in the group, Melinda French Gates, I did an interview with Jamal Crawford who is advising that group. I talked to Detlef Schrempf that was like as a 90s kid that was really fun for me to talk to Detlef Schrempf.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Logistical nightmare of putting an NBA team in Mexico City

quotes.speaker: Ramona Shelburne
quotes.summary_phrase: NBA expansion revenue sharing model with 30 teams
quotes.excerpt: think about this as the net pool that everybody's going to divide by 30
quotes.quote: Think about this as the net pool that everybody's going to divide by 30. If Vegas comes in between 10 and 11, that goes to everyone divided by 30. But if you leave Seattle out, instead of dividing 17 by 30 or 18 by 30, whatever it is, you're only dividing 11.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Board of Governors concerned about multiple expansion drafts
quotes.excerpt: it is fundamentally unfair to ask teams to have to deal with two different expansion drafts
quotes.quote: I was talking to one of the Board of Governors and they said all the logistics stuff that you want to talk about about having 31 teams and what not and the NBA Cup, they said it is fundamentally unfair to ask teams to have to deal with two different expansion drafts. That is fundamentally unfair and there will be a whole bunch of issues that come especially if they have to come potentially in like back-to-back years or two out of three years.

quotes.speaker: Ramona Shelburne
quotes.summary_phrase: Expansion draft could be the new amnesty for teams
quotes.excerpt: this could be the new amnesty
quotes.quote: This expansion draft guys is going to be fascinating because I've had one person describe it to me as, this could be the new amnesty.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Historical context of NBA amnesty and expansion drafts
quotes.excerpt: they allowed teams to waive a player and the player would get the money
quotes.quote: Two different times in NBA history basically when they after CBAs when they raised the tax penalties to get teams, you know, they had made four and five year investments and all of a sudden the tax rate goes way up, they allowed teams to waive a player and the player would get the money, but he would come off their books. It was known as the amnesty. They didn't do it in the last CBA, but one of the things that has happened with there hasn't been that many expansion teams in the modern era, there's only been one in this century, they haven't given them the full salary cap in year one. They've given them like a percentage of the cap in year one.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Mark Cuban's public suggestion to amnesty Kobe Bryant
quotes.excerpt: Mark Cuban suggested publicly that the Lakers should amnesty Kobe Bryant
quotes.quote: My favorite amnesty story is not even involved in a player who was amnestied. You'll remember this one Ramona, when Mark Cuban suggested publicly that the Lakers should amnesty Kobe Bryant. This was in 2013 and it was just before the Lakers came into Dallas. Kobe goes out and lights the Mavericks up for 38 and then he tweeted amnesty that.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: The first amnesty and the Allen Houston rule
quotes.quote: The first amnesty was in 2005 and Allen Houston was on the Knicks, but he'd gotten injured and he had like this enormous contract and people as they were creating the rule, people just started calling it the Allen Houston rule. They didn't use amnesty, they just said we're going to call this the Allen Houston rule because everybody's like, well the Knicks are going to amnesty Allen Houston. They didn't amnesty Allen Houston, they amnestied somebody else. They amnestied Junkyard Dog Jerome Williams.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Michael Finley's amnesty and championship with San Antonio
quotes.excerpt: the one guy who Cuban did amnesty was Michael Finley
quotes.quote: The one guy who Cuban did amnesty was Michael Finley who got all that he was owed on his max contract and then went to San Antonio, signed with them, was able to double dip, it was obviously not the same kind of money, and won a championship with San Antonio.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Expansion draft trade strategies and draft capital
quotes.excerpt: there's some teams that may not mind, especially if they can get some draft capital
quotes.quote: There's some teams that may not mind, especially if they can get some draft capital from a brand new team. Also there's there's other things that can happen in with expansion drafts like you could say, I really want you to take this player and they're like, well, we're kind of wishy-washy on this guy. Well, how about if I give you a draft pick to draft this player?

quotes.speaker: Ramona Shelburne
quotes.summary_phrase: Players left unprotected in expansion drafts will have bruised feelings
quotes.excerpt: there will be bruised feelings like if these players will know that they were left unprotected
quotes.quote: There will be bruised feelings like if these players will know that they were left unprotected and a lot of them will have to go back to their old teams and they'll be hurt feelings there. Some of them could get taken, there could be some really big names guys who are in their 30s, maybe on the back end of 30 that have a big deal that are hurt or haven't lived up to that money or whatever it is.

quotes.speaker: Ramona Shelburne
quotes.summary_phrase: Vegas as a global entertainment destination for NBA
quotes.excerpt: think of the NBA franchise, it's a global entertainment destination
quotes.quote: Think of the NBA franchise, it's a global entertainment destination. So your fan base is relatively small. The market size is not big compared to some of the other large markets, but you have so many people coming in from all over the world who want to have a fun night out. So your this is like a new residency. It's like Celine Dion went there. This is our new show in town.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Sports in the future will be played on a sound stage
quotes.excerpt: in the future sports were going to all just be played on a sound stage
quotes.quote: 20 years ago I once listened to a guy give a talk who said that in the future sports were going to all just be played on a sound stage. That's what happened in the bubble and essentially the sphere is like a studio.
